conservative.read: This plan aims for capital preservation with a target of around 1.5% monthly return. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, holding a larger cash buffer. Expect lower drawdowns but also slower growth.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly return by managing risk first. It reduces leverage and concentration, blending index exposure with quality tech and a small, controlled amount of leverage. Expect moderate growth with controlled drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring tech names, accepting higher potential upside and significantly larger drawdowns. Daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can impact performance.

plan: Increase SPY to 40% and QQQI to 30% to maximize income generation.

income.read: This income-focused plan targets ~1% monthly return through distributions. It prioritizes income-generating ETFs and broad index exposure while cutting leverage and high-beta single names. Expect low drawdowns and steady, though variable, income distributions.
